title: 第5章 西边捡来的项西(5)

content_zh:
项西看着可怜，就喂了点儿东西，打那天起狗就一直在这片转，项西没给它起名字，只是一吹口哨，狗就会跑过来。
今天三声口哨吹完，没看到狗欢蹦着的身影。
他转回了屋里，走到平叔身边：“叔，狗呢？”
平叔拿着茶壶看了他一眼，屋外传来一声惨叫，馒头被二盘打到了门外。
“狗呢？”项西从平叔的眼神里能看出些什么来，但不敢确定，只是执著地又问了一遍，“就那只黄狗，狗呢？”
屋里有人冷笑了一声，声音里透着莫名其妙的幸灾乐祸。
平叔还是没说话，头偏了偏，似乎是在听二盘揍馒头的动静。
项西没再问，转身出了门，两步拦在了正要往馒头肚子上踹过去的二盘面前。
“滚开！”二盘瞪着他。
“我的狗呢？”项西看着他，问了一句。
“谁知道什么狗不狗的，滚！”二盘胳膊一抡，把项西推开了。
“小展……”馒头在身后半蹲半坐地叫了他一声。
“我问你，”项西踉跄了两步，没理馒头，又飞快地拦在了二盘面前，几乎跟他脸对脸，“狗呢？”
“你有病啊！”二盘吼了一声，抬手一拳往项西脸上抡了过来。
项西晃了一下躲开了，在二盘的架势还没收全的时候他扑过去又狠狠地推了二盘一把，也吼了一声：“我的狗呢？！”
二盘大概是被他这份莫名其妙的执著感动了，一把拽着他的胳膊往墙上一抡：“你的狗，老子吃了！”
项西愣住了，肩膀狠狠地撞在墙上带来的疼痛都没顾得上认真体会。
“你说什么？”他猛地转过头瞪着二盘。
“我说你那条破狗老子吃了！炖了一锅！”二盘往地上啐了一口，骂骂咧咧地往馒头跟前走过去：“都是吃闲饭的，养着有什么用！”
二盘抬腿往正往后躲的馒头身上踹过去的时候，项西吼了一声，扑到了他身后，对着他脖子后边一胳膊肘砸了上去：“谁让你吃我的狗了！”

项西知道自己这一扑比拿鸡蛋往石头上磕还任性，二盘跟座塔似的，每次往他身边一站，他都觉得滚滚沙石遮天蔽日。
不过他还是扑上去了，然后在下一秒被二盘抓着胳膊从肩头扔在了地上。
他被摔得有点儿晕，今天就没怎么吃东西，再被这一摔，眼睛都花了，看着馒头的腿都一边长了……
二盘这一摔没解气，过来又往他腿上一脚跺了上去。
项西张了张嘴，没能喊出声。
太疼了，这一瞬间传来的疼痛让他只剩下了倒在地上喘的力气。
二盘还想再来两下，馒头抱住了他的腿，沉默地咬着牙没松劲。
二盘一巴掌甩在他脸上，正要再骂的时候，平叔从17号里走了出来，他看了平叔一眼，停了手。
“烦不烦？”平叔手里端着茶壶，声调不高地说着，“这条街你家的啊？也不嫌丢人，打自己家孩子打这么狠，出息！”
这话说完，平叔冲馒头抬了抬下巴：“扶他进去。”
馒头赶紧过去想把项西拉起来，项西脚刚一用力就皱着眉一屁股坐回了地上，馒头伸手想摸摸他的腿，被他挡开了：“别碰，疼。”
“断了？”馒头声音有点儿哆嗦，大概想起了当年自己被踹坏的腿。
“不知道。”项西咬牙攀着馒头的肩站了起来，腿在短短这点儿时间里已经感觉到了肿胀，没骨折才见鬼了。
馒头搀着他往屋里走，经过平叔身边的时候小声说了一句：“平叔，这得去……医院看看。”
“折了？”平叔看了项西一眼。
“大概吧。”项西说。
“是吗，”平叔笑了笑，“正好，过年了呢，干点儿力所能及的活儿吧。”
项西没再说话，他知道平叔的意思，明面上帮他，其实二盘揍他，平叔挺愉快的，现在骨折了也正好。
算惩罚吧，自己最近大概让平叔气不太顺。
入冬之后骨科的病人多了不少，大多是各种骨折，踩了冰滑倒折了腿的，踩了冰滑倒用手撑地折了手腕的……住院部和门诊都忙，程博衍今天在门诊忙得一直没停，急诊还送了好几个摔伤的过来。

又没能按时下班，给来复诊的最后一个病人检查完，他靠在椅子上伸了个懒腰，琢磨着晚饭去吃点儿什么好，不过脑子里立马回荡起了老妈的声音。

content_en:
Xiang west looked pitiful, so he fed him something. The dog had been wandering around here since that day. Xiang west didn't give it a name. He just whistled and the dog would run over.
After three whistles today, no dog was seen jumping happily.
He turned back into the house and walked to Uncle Ping: "Uncle, where is the dog?"
Uncle Ping glanced at him with the teapot, and there was a scream outside the house, and the steamed buns were knocked out of the door in two sets.
"Where's the dog?" Xiang west could see something from Uncle Ping's eyes, but he wasn't sure, so he just asked again persistently, "That yellow dog, where's the dog?"
Someone in the room sneered, with inexplicable schadenfreude in his voice.
Uncle Ping still said nothing and tilted his head, as if he was listening to the second set of steamed buns being beaten.
Xiang west didn't ask any more questions, turned around and walked out the door. He stopped in front of Erpan who was about to kick the steamed bun in the stomach.
"Go away!" Erpan glared at him.
"Where is my dog?" Xiang west looked at him and asked.
"Who knows what kind of dog is not a dog? Get out!" Erpan waved his arm and pushed Xiang west away.
"Xiao Zhan..." Mantou called him from behind, half squatting and half sitting.
"Let me ask you," Xiang west staggered two steps, ignored the steamed buns, and quickly stopped in front of the second set, almost face to face with him, "Where is the dog?"
"You are sick!" Erpan roared, raised his hand and punched Xiang west in the face.
Xiang Xi swayed and dodged. When the second set's posture was still intact, he rushed over and pushed the second set hard, and also yelled: "Where is my dog?!"
Erpan was probably moved by his inexplicable persistence, so he grabbed his arm and swung it against the wall: "I'll eat your dog!"
Xiang west was stunned, and he didn't even bother to feel the pain caused by his shoulder hitting the wall hard.
"What did you say?" He turned his head sharply and stared at the second set.
"I said I ate your broken dog! It stewed in a pot!" Erpan spat on the ground and walked over to the steamed buns with a curse: "They are all just for free, what's the use of raising them!"
When Erpan raised his leg and kicked Mantou who was hiding behind, Xiang Xi roared, threw himself behind him, and hit him with an elbow on the back of his neck: "Who told you to eat my dog!"
Xiang west knew that his move was more willful than knocking an egg on a stone. The second move was like a tower. Every time he stood next to him, he felt like the rolling sand and stones were blocking the sky and the sun.
However, he still rushed forward, and in the next second, Erpan grabbed his arm and threw him to the ground from his shoulders.
He was a little dizzy after being thrown, and he didn't eat much today. After being thrown again, his eyes were blurred, and the legs of the steamed buns grew longer on one side...
Unable to relieve his anger after the fall in the second set, he came over and stomped on his leg.
Xiang west opened his mouth, but couldn't shout.
It hurt so much that the pain that came from this moment left him with only the strength to fall to the ground and gasp.
After the second set, he wanted to have two more bites, but Mantou hugged his legs and gritted his teeth in silence without letting go.
Erpan slapped him in the face, and when he was about to curse again, Uncle Ping walked out of No. 17. He glanced at Uncle Ping and stopped.
"Are you annoyed?" Uncle Ping held the teapot in his hand and said in a low tone, "Is your family from this street? It's not shameful to beat your own children so hard, it's worth it!"
After saying this, Uncle Ping raised his chin towards the steamed bun: "Help him in."
Mantou hurried over and tried to pull Xiang Xi up. As soon as Xiang Xi exerted his strength, he frowned and sat back on the ground. Mantou reached out to touch his leg, but he blocked it: "Don't touch, it hurts."
"Broken?" Steamed Bun's voice was a little trembling, probably remembering his leg that was kicked badly back then.
"I don't know." Xiang west gritted his teeth and stood up on Mantou's shoulders. His legs had already felt swollen in such a short period of time. It would be damned if they weren't broken.
Steamed Bun helped him walk into the house and passed Uncle Ping.While walking by, he whispered: "Uncle Ping, I have to go to...the hospital."
"Broken?" Uncle Ping glanced at Xiang west.
"Probably." Xiang west said.
"Really?" Uncle Ping smiled, "It's just in time. It's the Chinese New Year, so let's do some work within our ability."
Xiang west didn't say anything anymore. He knew what Uncle Ping meant, and he helped him openly. In fact, he was very happy to beat him in the second round. It was just right now that he had broken bones.
Consider it punishment, I probably made Uncle Ping unhappy recently.
Since the beginning of winter, there have been a lot more patients in the orthopedics department, most of them suffering from various fractures. Those who slipped on the ice and broke their legs, slipped on the ice and broke their wrists with their hands... Both the inpatient department and the outpatient department were busy. Cheng Boyan was very busy in the outpatient department today, and the emergency department also sent several people who had fallen injuries.
He failed to get off work on time and after examining the last patient who came for follow-up consultation, he leaned on the chair and stretched, thinking about what to eat for dinner, but his mother's voice immediately echoed in his mind.
